motion_rule: he swings hand over hand along a market rail racing at the lens, the camera racing backwards ahead so the stalls tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; head half the frame, from 6.65 a low angle, head low, risen pan high; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; both macaques act in every beat; camera move every beat
character: a lean brown macaque in a grey waistcoat, deadpan
second_characters: ONE small macaque porter in a green visor on the rail behind him; from 5.05 he hauls down on the risen pan and rises with it
props: ONE brass balance beam with two identical pans, hooked on his tail; two identical brown coconuts, same size and husk, in his waistcoat
prop_continuity: the left pan hangs dead down from 1.0; the right pan rides up from 4.3 on a taut chain and never comes down, its coconut riding above him to the end
environment: a packed bazaar lane, stalls of fruit and brass to the ceiling both sides, the rail racing over
light_events: hard noon sun bars strobe his face every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: o-DIN, po-KA-zy-va-et, na-kop-LE-ni-ya, dru-GOY, kar-MI-che-ski-e, DOL-gi
audio.pacing: 0.45-3.55 one breath; the gap under one second; 4.5-7.15 one breath with no voice sound outside the lines; after 7.15 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: the rail singing, the bazaar roaring, a woody knock at 0.45, a chain slam at 1.0, a rising ring at 4.3, the chain creaking at 5.05

timeline.a: the beam swings into the lens off his tail, pans dead level, he is already swinging
he swings on one arm and drops a coconut into the left pan
the left pan slams down its chain and slings him along
he swings past the loaded pan hanging dead down
he hauls along the rail, the loaded pan swinging under him
he drops the other coconut into the right pan the same way
the right pan flies up past his ear, its coconut lifting off onto the taut chain
he swings on, the risen coconut riding above his head, going with him
the porter swings down the chain and throws his whole body onto the risen pan
the pan carries the porter up instead, both rising, he swings on
the risen pan tows him off the rail, the porter still hauling on it
he swats the riding coconut and it does not come down, the porter dragging its chain down
the porter hauls the chain with both arms and the pan takes him higher still
he swings the sunk pan past the lens, the risen one overhead with the porter on it
he throws himself into the lens, deadpan, the sunk pan at his ear and the risen pan overhead

must_appear: two identical coconuts; the first into the left pan at 0.45 slams it down; the same drop into the right pan at 3.55 sends it up at 4.3, its coconut riding above him; from 5.05 the porter hauls down on the risen pan and it lifts him instead; at 9.4 his deadpan face is in the lens, the sunk pan at his ear and the risen pan overhead
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, three coconuts in frame, more than two pans, a parked camera, a still background, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, the risen pan coming down, a word not in the lines, a drawn-out word, cyrillic letters, extra limbs
